# Les Vendredis

> Hébergement insolite à Sainte-Luce, Martinique : une A-frame en bois construite à la main, un jardin tropical privatif de 600m², un préau, une douche extérieure. Lieu de famille ouvert aux voyageurs quand nous n'y sommes pas.

## What Les Vendredis Is
- A family-built A-frame cabin in the hills of Sainte-Luce, southern Martinique.
- Built by hand over two years (2022–2024) by Bolo, Anaïs, and friends on family land.
- 18m² A-frame + covered préau (outdoor kitchen/living area) + 600m² private tropical garden.
- Loft bed under the gable, equipped kitchen, outdoor solar shower with hot water.
- No AC — trade winds cool the A-frame naturally. No TV. WiFi is limited (hills).
- 5 minutes by car from Sainte-Luce beaches (Corps de Garde, Gros Raisin, Anse Désert).
- 20 minutes on foot from Roches Gravées de Montravail (Amerindian petroglyphs, listed Historical Monument).
- Pets welcome. Samsam the Creole dog and Dimdim the rooster live on the property (depending on period).

## What Les Vendredis Is Not
- Not a hotel or standardized rental. It's a lived-in family home opened when the family is away.
- No autonomous check-in. Guests are welcomed in person or via a human contact.
- Not suitable for groups or parties. Built for couples, small families (2 adults + 1 child), or solo travelers.

## Pricing Anchor
- From 80€/night, direct booking.
- 2 nights minimum.
- Also listed on Airbnb and Booking.com (slightly higher due to platform fees).

## Booking Flow
- Direct: contact Bolo via email (hello@lesvendredis.casa) or the [Venir dormir](https://lesvendredis.casa/fr/venir-dormir/) page.
- Platforms: Airbnb (A-Frame des Roches Gravées) or Booking.com (Les Vendredis).

## Proof Points
- Built by hand, not a kit. Documented in the journal from 2022 to 2024.
- Family-run, not agency-managed. Bolo and Anaïs live there when it's not rented.
- Real photos only — no staging, no renders. What you see is what you get.
- Located on Route de Zaire, Montravail, Sainte-Luce, Martinique (250m altitude, forest setting).
